0022600234.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, 13th in the East) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (7-3, 5-0 on the road, 7th in the West), with Brooklyn on a two-game losing streak and Memphis riding a one-game winning streak. Brooklyn is missing Mikel Brown Jr. (illness; averaging 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes this season) and Nolan Traore (calf soreness), while Memphis is without Richie Saunders (knee, surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and Brooklyn won the most recent meeting 126-115 in Brooklyn on March 9, 2026.
